summary: Map service workflows, clarify decision rights and build a governance roadmap for social protection delivery. Explore the five-day course.
lede: E-governance for social protection connects programme rules, service workflows and accountable digital public-service delivery. For programme managers, service designers and public-sector digital teams, the course builds practical skills in mapping service journeys, clarifying decision rights and assigning responsibility across teams. Participants also practise translating rules into workflows, identifying accountability gaps and defining measures to review service performance.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape, operate or oversee the public-service processes that support social protection delivery. It is designed for people who need clearer accountability, workable service workflows and evidence for operational decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social protection programmes, public-service operations or digital service delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
